scope: Layered runtime/workflow/protocol/UI/transport/storage/tool-broker audit; some entries describe overlapping guards at distinct layers. Not a claim that every field length is a defect.
policyDecision: Clean pre-release contract cutover, no legacy runtime/checkpoint support. No aggregate hard quota by default for new runs; explicit user caps optional. Archive old data without deleting it. No production change applied by this audit.

entries.title: Run generation quota
entries.condition: Managed owner run without explicit managedBudget; factory injects ProjectRunBudgets.
entries.effect: Next generation refused with RUN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
entries.recommendation: Versioned optional aggregate cap; preserve explicit user limits and historical charges.
entries.tests: Beyond64 without cap; explicit64 blocks before dispatch; restart/idempotency preserve charges.

entries.title: Run output reservation quota
entries.condition: Reserves request output allowance, not actual completion tokens.
entries.stopScope: Output grant shrinks; less than minimum headroom stops generation.
entries.effect: Output grant shrinks; less than minimum headroom stops generation.
entries.recommendation: Make aggregate cap optional; retain reserved/observed/unknown usage as distinct facts.
entries.tests: Unlimited total with finite request output; exact finite-cap shrink; unknown outcome never refunded.

entries.title: Run tool and check quota

entries.effect: Next tool/check rejected before effects.
entries.recommendation: Optional user cap; preserve atomic effect admission.
entries.tests: More than256 known effects without cap; explicit cap; service-check charges; no duplicated effects.

entries.title: Review reserve reduces work allowance

entries.effect: Work stops at56 requests despite global64; review reserve is a protected minimum, not a review maximum.
entries.recommendation: Reserve only within an explicitly finite user envelope.
entries.tests: Work56 blocked, review8 available; no artificial subtraction in observation-only mode.

entries.title: Finite required cap schema and constructor

entries.stopScope: Deleting settings does not create unlimited mode.
entries.effect: Deleting settings does not create unlimited mode.
entries.recommendation: Explicit version2 optional caps, separate mandatory model/request capacity; avoid huge sentinels.
entries.tests: Omitted/null wire behavior; oldv1 roundtrip; new no-cap state; migration retains receipts.

entries.tests: More than17408 receipts; duplicate/conflicting operations; recovery and summaries.

entries.effect: Loop exhausts MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED independently of run cap.

entries.condition: large changed source/artifact
entries.effect: Legitimate large file modification can fail verification even with no model quota.
entries.recommendation: Use full versioned blobs/stream hashes and paged review excerpts; never silently mark incomplete source as fully reviewed.
tests: Modify/delete large file; complete before/after integrity; diff/review retrieval and scope checks remain correct.

entries.title: 32MiB Git stdout maxBuffer; someoperations1MiB
entries.value: 32MiB Git stdout maxBuffer; someoperations1MiB
entries.condition: huge path lists/Git operation output
entries.effect: Process can fail due buffer instead of task semantics.
entries.recommendation: Stream/NUL-page metadata; separate full immutable artifact from UI output.
tests: Large path lists; binary names; cancellation and no partial accepted result.

entries.title: environment recipe fingerprint max32MiB/10000files
entries.value: environment recipe fingerprint max32MiB/10000files
entries.condition: recipe points to very broad source/dependency tree
entries.effect: Stops before setup; prevents expensive broad hashing but blocks overly broad valid recipe.
entries.recommendation: Select exact toolchain inputs, content-addressed incremental hashes; retain symlink/privacy guards.
tests: Large genuine config with incremental hash; node_modules not accidentally selected; environment revisions invalidate correctly.

entries.title: recipe inputs40, variables40*4000chars, setup8, ready1..8; eachcommand1s..15min
entries.value: recipe inputs40, variables40*4000chars, setup8, ready1..8; eachcommand1s..15min
entries.condition: large generated recipe
entries.effect: Cannot represent large recipe in single response; reserved env-root replacement is forbidden separately.
entries.recommendation: Use reusable versioned recipe steps/dependencies; retain reserved root and command authority protections.
tests: Long recipe split across saved phases; environment variables cannot override service roots.

entries.title: Docker rejected when privateDataIsolation=true
entries.value: Docker rejected when privateDataIsolation=true
entries.condition: managed API model needs prepared private isolation but Docker selected
entries.effect: UI permits choosing Docker although managed environment cannot supply required protection.
entries.recommendation: Capability-aware UI/preflight and supported isolated Docker executor; do not bypass isolation to remove a limit.
tests: Ollama/DeepSeek Docker unavailable before inference; native supported mode unchanged; no host fallback.

entries.title: preview readiness60s; HTTPprobe1s; poll300ms; shutdowngrace1200ms
entries.value: preview readiness60s; HTTPprobe1s; poll300ms; shutdowngrace1200ms
entries.condition: slow application boot/stop
entries.effect: Preview fails before app eventually starts; shutdown forceskill aftergrace.
entries.recommendation: Make readiness explicitly component-configurable; preserve owned cleanup and truthful unavailable state.
tests: Slow valid boot; stuck readiness; siblings shut down; user goal acceptance not falsely changed.

entries.title: deploy command15min; postdeployHTTPverify15s
entries.value: deploy command15min; postdeployHTTPverify15s
entries.condition: slow deployment or verification
entries.effect: Stops delivery or leaves external outcome needing reconciliation; cannot blindly retry.
entries.recommendation: Explicit deployment policy/job reconciliation independent of coding quota.
tests: Remote effect completed despite lost response; no duplicate deployment; acceptedcode preserved.

entries.title: no explicit run/history cap; full in-memory snapshot and history replay; GC onlyrepersists/state-temp cleanup
entries.value: no explicit run/history cap; full in-memory snapshot and history replay; GC onlyrepersists/state-temp cleanup
entries.condition: long-lived many-goal or no-default-quota operation
entries.effect: Physical memory/latency becomes effective ceiling; outgoing snapshots are not protected by inbound frame limit.
entries.recommendation: Paged read models, append-only event/artifact storage and incremental subscriptions; retain receipt/replay correctness.
tests: Large history/reconnect boundedmemory; gaps/duplicates absent; old accepted evidence still readable.

entries.title: allowed/protected scope, nonoverlap, registeredchecks, freshreview, frozenCAS and unknown-outcome guards
entries.value: allowed/protected scope, nonoverlap, registeredchecks, freshreview, frozenCAS and unknown-outcome guards
entries.condition: proposal/changes exceed ownership or requiredcheck/review missing
entries.effect: Stops unauthorized or unverified work irrespective of usage policy.
entries.recommendation: Retain. Observation-only quotas must not weaken authorization, protectedchecks, actual process observation or unknown-effect reconciliation.
tests: Unlimited policy still rejects out-ofscope/forged/stale evidence and unknown-action replay.

entries.title: Whole-file read ceiling precedes line selection
entries.condition: Any read_file/edit_file of a larger existing text file
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Even a one-line read or small replacement is rejected before requested range selection.
entries.recommendation: Use bounded streaming/range reads and hash/version-fenced edits; do not remove the check while still loading entire files into memory.
tests: Read and edit a small range of a >256000-byte file with bounded memory and intact source hash precondition.
Retain binary/symlink/private-path rejection.

entries.title: Read view has no within-line continuation
entries.condition: Requested lines exceed the text-view cap, especially a long line
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: View can stop within a line; lineCount alone cannot retrieve the remainder.
entries.recommendation: Return explicit truncation metadata and a versioned continuation cursor; retain bounded per-response size.
tests: Retrieve a long line across pages without skipped/duplicated text.
Reject cursors after source revision changes.

entries.title: Directory enumeration and search corpus ceilings
entries.condition: Large directory traversal or search_text over a directory
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Files after the cap cannot be reached through this listing without knowing narrower paths; truncated flag exists but there is no cursor.
entries.recommendation: Introduce indexed/paged discovery and search; a page bound should not be a lifetime corpus exclusion.
tests: Discover a matching file after entry300 and5000 using explicit pages.
Maintain private/generated/symlink filtering.

entries.title: Literal search result and snippet caps
entries.condition: Many matches or a very long matching line
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Large refactors may omit later matches; no match continuation cursor.
entries.recommendation: Versioned result pagination with stable ordering and fetchable full context for a selected hit.
tests: Fetch >50 results and the remainder of a long matching line.

entries.title: Exact replacement payload cap

value.matchingRule: one exact unique oldText; existing file cannot use empty oldText

entries.condition: Large replacement/create or an edit requiring a different format
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Patch fails validation or cannot be expressed; repeated attempts consume work without fixing the format mismatch.
entries.recommendation: Provide model-specific hash-fenced edit formats and bounded batch/chunk application through the same scoped broker.
tests: Duplicate base hashes/ambiguous replacements/partial batch outcomes must not corrupt or replay.
Compare patch, exact replace and bounded whole-file format on same tasks.

entries.title: Configured-command output is a truncated model view
entries.condition: A registered check emits longer output
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Tool reply retains only a tail; earlier evidence must be accessible separately.
entries.recommendation: Stream full logs to a private artifact and return a bounded view plus reference; fix underlying command collector tail loss tracked in WF17.
tests: Early failure in a >30K log remains retrievable through a private artifact.

entries.title: Diff body truncation lacks an explicit completeness receipt
entries.condition: Large tracked or untracked diff
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: The reviewer can receive a partial diff string without a full-content receipt.
entries.recommendation: Provide per-file paginated/full verified diff artifacts and explicit complete/truncated fields. Approval must not assume a clipped view is complete.
tests: Place a defect after character24000 and require more context or block complete-evidence approval.

entries.title: Diff path limits are separate from diff text size
entries.condition: Large change sets
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Some changed files are absent from the view even before text clipping.
entries.recommendation: Page manifests independently from file content and tie them to the same workspace revision.
tests: Review a manifest beyond300 tracked/100 untracked paths without implying completeness.

entries.title: No explicit delete or rename model tool
entries.condition: A goal requires removing or moving source files
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Empty replacement is not file deletion; arbitrary mv/rm commands are not authorized.
entries.recommendation: Add typed version/hash-fenced move/delete/change operations through the existing permission and effect journal. Do not add unrestricted shell as a shortcut.
tests: Source and destination scope, protected targets, symlinks, cancellation and unknown partial effects.

entries.title: Read-only and configured command authority
entries.condition: Any model tool dispatch
entries.stopScope: tool result / edit capability / evidence view
entries.effect: Correctly prevents unauthorized effects; no-quota is not a permission expansion.
entries.recommendation: Retain these guards and explicit capability reporting while changing resource policies.
tests: No quota mode cannot write outside assignment, alter protected checks, or execute an unregistered command.
